$comment: Event inventory. The site's entire event infrastructure is broken - both event URLs return HTTP 404. Metadata below was captured from the Phase 1 discovery index and is NOT verified against a live page.

events.title: Bazaar and Flea Market Performance
events.descriptionAvailable: Only the index snippet survives: 'This event has passed. Bazaar and Flea Market Performance. March 15, 2025 @ 10:00 am.'
events.relatedProgram: Supports the /resources/ claim: 'We actively engage in community outreach through free performances'
events.verificationNote: Date and time come from search-index metadata for a URL that no longer resolves. Must be confirmed with the owner before any reuse.
events.migrationRecommendation: DO NOT migrate the URL. Recover the real event record from the owner and rebuild as part of a new Performances/Events section. If external links point here, 301 to the new performances page.

events.title: Events for March 2025
events.descriptionAvailable: Index snippet: 'Empowering musicians of all levels with quality lessons and expert guidance. Join South Dade Music and let your passion for music thrive! Instagram.'
events.eventType: Calendar month archive (The Events Calendar plugin)
events.verificationNote: Two significant details in the snippet: the page title used 'South Dade Music Academy', and the footer referenced Instagram - the only evidence of any social media presence in the entire estate.
events.migrationRecommendation: Archive. Do not rebuild the /events/month/YYYY-MM/ URL pattern. Recover the Instagram handle and the full event history from the owner.

performanceEvidence.note: Although no event pages work, several performance references exist across the estate. These are the only surviving records of what the academy actually stages.

sources.detail: Six images (P1088527, DSCF3094, P1088689, P1088608, P1088597, P1088570) - unedited camera filenames, all uploaded 2026/05, apparently from a single showcase shoot. No date, venue or event name is published for them.
'The concert was a heartwarming showcase of the kids' talent, joy, and hard work' - references a concert with no date.
'Had the pleasure of attending a lovely event hosted by South Dade music Academy... it was clear how much care and dedication went into organizing the showcase.'
'my niece was in the show and she's been having so much fun at practice'
'I am the grandpa of two of the performers Dexter & Michael Munroe... to see my gran kids worshiping the Lord' - implies a faith-based performance context not documented anywhere on the main site.
'End-of-Camp Concert' with 'Parent Invitation to Attend'. Two 2026 concerts implied (end of Session 1, end of Session 2) - both now past. No record published.
'every student performs in a live showcase within 90 days' implies roughly four showcase cycles per year. None is documented.
PHOTO-2025-06-28-19-06-09.jpg - filename dates it to 28 June 2025, 19:06, i.e. an evening event during the 2025 summer camp period.

findings.criticalGap: A business whose entire brand promise is 'every student performs in a live showcase within 90 days' publishes ZERO event records. There is no upcoming-events listing, no past-showcase archive, no dates, no venues, and no video. The only event page that ever existed now returns 404.
findings.pluginRemoval: The Events Calendar plugin appears to have been removed while its URLs stayed in the sitemap. Both /event/... and /events/month/... 404 with a noindex 404 template.
findings.sitemapPollution: Both dead URLs were returned by the Phase 1 site map, meaning they are still discoverable and may still be indexed.
findings.lostSocialSignal: The March 2025 archive footer referenced Instagram. The current site links to no social profile at all.
recommendationForRedesign: Build a real Events/Showcases section with structured Event schema
Backfill past showcases with dates, venues and photo sets before launch
Publish the recurring showcase cadence so the 90-day promise is verifiable
301 both dead URLs to the new performances section
